def api(self, route, data=None, method=None):
        u = (f"{self.base}/index.php?rest_route="
             f"{urllib.parse.quote(route, safe='/&=')}")
        body = json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            u, data=body, headers=self.h,
            method=method or ("POST" if data is not None else "GET"))
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as r:
                raw = r.read()
                return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            detail = e.read()[:300].decode("utf-8", "replace")
            raise RuntimeError(f"WP {method or 'GET'} {route}: "
                               f"{e.code} {detail}") from e

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """News situations — flag, promote, index (card news-situation-summaries). Digest parents on the WP `news` CPT already ARE evolving topic summaries (topic/brief/diffs/Developments from news-digest.py). A "situation" is a digest the household is tracking — flagged via meta `situation` = watching|pinned, mirrored as the `situation-watching` / `situation-pinned` post_tag so the flag works before chaba-boards 0.6.0 deploys (meta keys are unregistered until then and REST silently drops them). Signals are additive and never silent — every transition posts a WP comment on the digest naming the actor and reason: auto-nominate sweep: multi-source (>= --sources feeds) or disaster-desk digests get watching. Never pins, never demotes. member-ask ask "": match the ask to a digest (embedding cosine, ngram fallback) and promote one step — none->watching, watching->pinned. Prints TH+EN briefs for the asker (Ada/household reporting). Weak match -> exit 3, no write. comment wp-comment-sync.py parses pin/unpin/watch commands on news posts and calls the same transition path. sticky pin also sets WP sticky so the digest floats on /wp/news/; unpin/clear removes it. Index: `index` upserts a private WP page (slug `situations`, TH-first) that household members read at /wp/; the [chaba_situations] shortcode renders the same list inside any page. Usage: news-situation.py list [--json] news-situation.py set [--by X] [--note T] news-situation.py promote [--by X] [--note T] news-situation.py demote [--by X] [--note T] news-situation.py ask "สรุปข่าวน้ำท่วม" [--by tony] [--json] [--dry-run] news-situation.py sweep [--sources 3] [--dry-run] news-situation.py index [--slug situations] [--dry-run] Env: WP_BOARDS_ENV path to wp-boards.env (parsed, never sourced) """ import argparse import base64 import html import importlib.util import json import os import re import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone ENV_PATH = os.environ.get( "WP_BOARDS_ENV", os.path.expanduser("~/.config/secrets/wp-boards.env")) ICT = timezone(timedelta(hours=7)) UA = "chaba-news-situation/1.0" TAG_RE = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>") STATES = ("watching", "pinned") # additive ladder order TAG_FOR = {"watching": "situation-watching", "pinned": "situation-pinned"} SITUATION_TAGS = set(TAG_FOR.values()) INDEX_SLUG = "situations" ASK_THRESHOLD = 0.55 # cosine floor for ask->digest match DISASTER_CAT = "disaster" # desk slug auto-nominates watching DIGEST_SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^d-") def _load_env(path): env = {} try: for line in open(path): m = re.match(r"^([A-Z_]+)=(.*)$", line.strip()) if m: env[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip().strip('"').strip("'") except OSError: pass return env def _news_digest(): """Import sibling news-digest.py for embed/cos/norm/trigram fallback.""" path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "news-digest.py") spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("news_digest", path) m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec) spec.loader.exec_module(m) return m class WP: def __init__(self): env = _load_env(ENV_PATH) for k in ("WP_SITE_URL", "WP_APP_USER", "WP_APP_PASSWORD"): if k not in env: raise SystemExit(f"missing {k} in {ENV_PATH}") self.base = env["WP_SITE_URL"].rstrip("/") tok = base64.b64encode( f'{env["WP_APP_USER"]}:{env["WP_APP_PASSWORD"]}'.encode()).decode() self.h = {"Authorization": f"Basic {tok}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": UA} self._cats = None self._tags = None def api(self, route, data=None, method=None): u = (f"{self.base}/index.php?rest_route=" f"{urllib.parse.quote(route, safe='/&=')}") body = json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None req = urllib.request.Request( u, data=body, headers=self.h, method=method or ("POST" if data is not None else "GET")) try: with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as r: raw = r.read() return json.loads(raw) if raw else {} except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: detail = e.read()[:300].decode("utf-8", "replace") raise RuntimeError(f"WP {method or 'GET'} {route}: " f"{e.code} {detail}") from e def cat_names(self, ids): if self._cats is None: self._cats = {c["id"]: c["slug"] for c in self.api("/wp/v2/categories&per_page=100")} return [self._cats.get(i, str(i)) for i in ids] def tag_ids(self, names): if self._tags is None: self._tags = {t["name"].lower(): t["id"] for t in self.api("/wp/v2/tags&per_page=100")} ids = [] for n in names: k = n.lower() if k not in self._tags: self._tags[k] = self.api("/wp/v2/tags", {"name": n})["id"] ids.append(self._tags[k]) return ids def tag_names(self, ids): if self._tags is None: self.tag_ids([]) by_id = {v: k for k, v in self._tags.items()} return [by_id.get(i, str(i)) for i in ids] def strip(s): return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", TAG_RE.sub(" ", html.unescape(s or ""))).strip() def brief_th_of(post): """Thai brief for a digest: meta.brief_th once chaba-boards 0.6.0 registers the key; until then fall back to the สรุป paragraph news-digest renders into the post body.""" m = ((post.get("meta") or {}).get("brief_th") or "").strip() if m: return m body = (post.get("content") or {}).get("rendered", "") hit = re.search(r'

]*>\s*สรุป:\s*' r"(.*?)

", body, re.S) return strip(hit.group(1)) if hit else "" def effective_state(post, wp=None): """meta first, tag mirror second. '' = not a situation.""" m = ((post.get("meta") or {}).get("situation") or "").strip().lower() if m in STATES: return m tags = post.get("_tag_names") if tags is None: ids = post.get("tags") or [] tags = wp.tag_names(ids) if (wp and ids) else [] return next((s for s in STATES if TAG_FOR[s] in tags), "") def digest_posts(wp, hours=24 * 14, per_page=100): """Recently-modified digest parents (slug d-*) — the evolving summaries. modified_after (not after) so a long-running situation whose parent was created weeks ago stays in the window while it keeps updating.""" after = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=hours) ).isoformat(timespec="seconds") posts = wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news&modified_after={after}&per_page={per_page}" "&orderby=modified&order=desc") return [p for p in posts if DIGEST_SLUG_RE.match(p.get("slug") or "")] def source_count(post): feeds = (post.get("meta") or {}).get("source_feed") or "" n = len([f for f in feeds.split("+") if f and f != "?"]) if n: return n tags = post.get("_tag_names") or [] counts = [int(t.split(":", 1)[1]) for t in tags if t.startswith("sources:") and t.split(":", 1)[1].isdigit()] return max(counts) if counts else 0 def comment(wp, post_id, text, dry_run=False): """Transition trail — every flag change is announced on the post.""" if dry_run: print(f" [dry] comment on {post_id}: {text}") return None try: return wp.api("/wp/v2/comments", {"post": post_id, "content": text}).get("id") except Exception as e: print(f" warn: comment on {post_id} failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr) return None def sync_meta_from_tag(wp, post, state, dry_run=False): """Backfill registered meta when only the tag mirror holds the flag — flags set before chaba-boards 0.6.0 deployed had their meta silently dropped by REST (unregistered keys). Silent in WP: the transition comment was already posted, this is convergence not a transition. Returns True when a write was (or would be) made.""" m = post.get("meta") or {} if (m.get("situation") or "").strip().lower() == state: return False if not dry_run: wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news/{post['id']}", {"meta": { "situation": state, "situation_since": m.get("situation_since") or datetime.now(ICT).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "situation_by": m.get("situation_by") or "tag-sync"}}) return True def set_state(wp, post, state, by="system", note="", dry_run=False): """Apply one ladder position: meta + tag mirror + sticky + comment. state '' clears. Idempotent — returns (old, new, changed).""" old = effective_state(post, wp) if old == state: if state: sync_meta_from_tag(wp, post, state, dry_run) return old, state, False pid = post["id"] # keep raw tag ids — only drop ids whose resolved name is a situation tag tag_ids_now = list(post.get("tags") or []) names_now = wp.tag_names(tag_ids_now) keep = [i for i, n in zip(tag_ids_now, names_now) if n not in SITUATION_TAGS] if state: keep += wp.tag_ids([TAG_FOR[state]]) meta = {"situation": state, "situation_since": "", "situation_by": ""} if state: meta["situation_since"] = datetime.now(ICT).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") meta["situation_by"] = by payload = {"tags": sorted(set(keep)), "meta": meta} if state == "pinned": payload["sticky"] = True elif old == "pinned" or not state: payload["sticky"] = False title = strip((post.get("title") or {}).get("rendered")) arrow = f"{old or '—'} → {state or '—'}" if not dry_run: try: wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news/{pid}", payload) except RuntimeError as e: # hierarchical CPTs reject `sticky` on some WP versions — # drop it and retry rather than lose the flag write. if "sticky" in payload and "sticky" in str(e): print(" warn: sticky unsupported on news — flag only", file=sys.stderr) payload.pop("sticky") wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news/{pid}", payload) else: raise trail = f"situation {arrow} — by {by}" if note: trail += f" — {note}" comment(wp, pid, trail, dry_run) print(f" {pid} {title[:60]!r}: {arrow} (by {by})") return old, state, True def promote_step(state): return "pinned" if state == "watching" else ("watching" if not state else "pinned") def demote_step(state): return "watching" if state == "pinned" else "" def find_post(wp, ident): if str(ident).isdigit(): return wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news/{int(ident)}") r = wp.api(f"/wp/v2/news&slug={urllib.parse.quote(str(ident))}&per_page=1") if isinstance(r, list) and r: return r[0] raise SystemExit(f"no news post for {ident!r}") # ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands def cmd_list(wp, args): posts = digest_posts(wp) rows = [] for p in posts: p["_tag_names"] = wp.tag_names(p.get("tags") or []) st = effective_state(p) if not st and not args.all: continue rows.append({"id": p["id"], "state": st or "—", "sources": source_count(p), "by": (p.get("meta") or {}).get("situation_by") or "", "since": (p.get("meta") or {}).get("situation_since") or "", "title": strip(p["title"]["rendered"]), "link": p.get("link")}) if args.json: print(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) return 0 if not rows: print("no situation digests") for r in rows: icon = {"pinned": "📌", "watching": "👁"}.get(r["state"], " ") print(f"{icon} {r['id']:<6} {r['state']:<8} src:{r['sources']:<2} " f"{r['title'][:80]}") return 0 def cmd_set(wp, args, verb=None): post = find_post(wp, args.ident) post["_tag_names"] = wp.tag_names(post.get("tags") or []) cur = effective_state(post) if verb == "promote": target = promote_step(cur) elif verb == "demote": target = demote_step(cur) else: target = "" if args.state in ("none", "clear", "") else args.state if target not in STATES and target != "": raise SystemExit(f"state must be watching|pinned|none") old, new, changed = set_state(wp, post, target, by=args.by, note=args.note, dry_run=args.dry_run) if not changed: print(f" unchanged (already {new or '—'})") return 0 def cmd_ask(wp, args): """Member-ask hook: match ask text -> digest, promote one step, answer with the digest's briefs. This is the function Ada/agents call.""" posts = digest_posts(wp) if not posts: print("no digests to match against", file=sys.stderr) return 3 nd = _news_digest() ask_text = nd.norm(args.text) cand_texts = [nd.norm(strip(p["title"]["rendered"]) + " " + strip((p.get("content") or {}) .get("rendered", ""))[:400]) for p in posts] try: url, key = nd._load_litellm() embs = nd.embed([ask_text] + cand_texts, url, key) scores = [nd.cos(embs[0], e) for e in embs[1:]] except Exception as e: print(f"warn: embeddings unavailable ({e}) — ngram fallback", file=sys.stderr) a = nd.trigram_fallback(ask_text) scores = [len(a & nd.trigram_fallback(t)) / max(1, min(len(a), len(nd.trigram_fallback(t)))) for t in cand_texts] best = max(range(len(posts)), key=lambda i: scores[i]) title = strip(posts[best]["title"]["rendered"]) print(f"best match: [{scores[best]:.3f}] {posts[best]['id']} {title!r}") if scores[best] < args.threshold: print(f"below threshold {args.threshold} — no promotion " f"(suggestion-only: rerun with --threshold to override)") return 3 post = posts[best] post["_tag_names"] = wp.tag_names(post.get("tags") or []) cur = effective_state(post) if args.dry_run: new = cur print(f"[dry] would promote {cur or '—'} -> {promote_step(cur)}") else: _, new, _ = set_state(wp, post, promote_step(cur), by=args.by, note=f'member ask: "{args.text[:120]}"') meta = post.get("meta") or {} out = {"post_id": post["id"], "title": title, "link": post.get("link"), "state": new or cur, "score": round(scores[best], 3), "brief_th": brief_th_of(post), "brief_en": re.sub(r"]+>", "", (post.get("content") or {}) .get("rendered", "")).strip()[:400]} if args.json: print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False)) else: if out["brief_th"]: print(f"TH: {out['brief_th']}") print(f"EN: {out['brief_en'][:300]}") print(f"-> {out['state']} {out['link']}") return 0 def cmd_sweep(wp, args): """Auto-nominate: multi-source or disaster-desk digests -> watching. Suggestion-only: never pins, never demotes, never touches flagged posts.""" posts = digest_posts(wp) cats = wp.api("/wp/v2/categories&per_page=100") disaster_ids = {c["id"] for c in cats if c.get("slug") == DISASTER_CAT} disaster_ids |= {c["id"] for c in cats if c.get("parent") in disaster_ids} nom = synced = 0 for p in posts: p["_tag_names"] = wp.tag_names(p.get("tags") or []) st = effective_state(p) if st: if sync_meta_from_tag(wp, p, st, dry_run=args.dry_run): synced += 1 print(f" {p['id']}: meta <- tag ({st})") continue why = [] if source_count(p) >= args.sources: why.append(f"{source_count(p)} sources") if set(p.get("categories") or []) & disaster_ids: why.append("disaster desk") if not why: continue nom += 1 set_state(wp, p, "watching", by="auto-nominate", note=" + ".join(why), dry_run=args.dry_run) print(f"sweep: {nom} nominated, {synced} meta-backfilled " f"(of {len(posts)} digests)") return 0 def render_index(wp, rows): now = datetime.now(ICT).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") def row(r): brief = r.get("brief_th") or r["meta"].get("brief_th") or "" icon = "📌" if r["state"] == "pinned" else "👁" s = (f'
